blocking_reason: The active source set and corrected output-domain contract are frozen, but all three active backbones must pass v3 official GPU smoke and G13 must be recomputed before full training.

candidate_change.timing: before confirmatory full training and before any MPRNet holdout result
candidate_change.reason: The verified Windows host cannot build the official MambaIR CUDA extensions; MPRNet provides an official motion-deblurring implementation without that custom extension dependency.

output_domain_correction.timing: after a seven-step training-only smoke and before holdout evaluation or full training
output_domain_correction.reason: The v2 hard-clamped fidelity path drove MPRNet to 99.996% below zero after one update and 100% below zero after three updates, producing a zero-gradient clamp lock. The native official restoration output recovers when fidelity is optimized before clipping.
output_domain_correction.rule: All active backbones and both arms optimize fidelity on the selected preclip output; frozen DeepCrack inference and every evaluation/export use the same output clamped to [0,1].

primary_design.comparison: within-backbone paired base package versus MERIT full package
primary_design.capacity_policy: use one frozen native official configuration per family; disclose parameters/FLOPs and do not claim cross-family architectural superiority
primary_design.package_parameter_rule: within each backbone, base and MERIT arms must have identical trainable parameter count

input.channel_1: directional blur prompt map; zero for base, correct frozen oracle for MERIT
input.channel_2: noise prompt map; zero for base, correct frozen oracle for MERIT

adapter.policy: do not edit upstream source; wrap the unchanged official model, select the manifest-frozen final output, and retain channel 0 as the grayscale restoration
adapter.mprnet_output_rule: sequence index 0 only, matching official Deblurring/test.py and the stage-3 residual output order in Deblurring/MPRNet.py
adapter.base_full_identity_rule: the exact same wrapper, selected-output rule, and official architecture instance definition is used in both package arms

training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final step only; recovery checkpoints cannot be selected by outcome
training.mprnet_deep_supervision_policy: Do not add the official three-stage loss. The common G11 objective is applied to official final sequence index 0 in both arms.
training.data_order: same frozen D0 parent-disjoint bank and seed-specific stream within every paired arm

nafnet.license: MIT for NAFNet code; bundled BasicSR Apache-2.0 notices retained

paired_training_stream_freeze.authorization_effect: This closes the paired-stream subgate only and does not authorize full training.

closure_requirements: Pass read-only source preflight v3 for NAFNet, Restormer, and MPRNet.
Pass v3 base/full initial-state and trainable-parameter equality for every active backbone.
Pass v3 bfloat16 forward/backward smoke and record peak memory, step time, output range, and FLOP coverage status for every active backbone.
Reject any backbone with non-finite values or complete clamp saturation after the corrected preclip optimization path.
Recompute G13 from v3 official-model timings before any full run.
